04 / HOSTING, MAINTENANCE & SUPPORT

What happens after launch matters, too.

Getting your website or web application online is only part of the process. We also help with hosting, maintenance, and technical support, so you know what happens after delivery.

01

Hosting

Hosting is included in the project price for the agreed coverage period, with the details outlined before launch.

02

Maintenance

An agreed period of maintenance is included after delivery. Further maintenance or changes can be arranged separately.

03

Technical Support

If you need help after launch, we're available through the support arrangements defined in your agreement.

Ask About Support↗

05 / HOW WE WORK

Here's how your idea takes shape.

Every project is different, but our approach stays clear. Here's what working with ORVEN looks like, step by step.

01

Discover

We start with a conversation about your business, your audience, the challenges you're facing, and what you want to achieve.

02

Plan

We define the project's requirements, scope, priorities, and expected timeline so everyone knows what's included.

03

Design

We turn the plan into layouts and interfaces, focusing on clarity and how people will use the product.

04

Develop & Test

We build the approved solution, test its functionality and responsiveness, and address issues before launch.

05

Launch & Support

We prepare and launch your project, then provide the maintenance and support agreed upon before delivery.

06 / LET'S WORK TOGETHER

Not sure where to start?

You don't need to have everything figured out. Tell us about your business and what you're trying to achieve, and we'll help you explore the right solution.
